name: Temari-Zushi Japanese Cuisine
notes: Restaurant's own PDF menu, linked from temarizushi.com (filename dates to 2016 but was re-uploaded Feb 2026 and price level is current — drinks .50-7, apps -18, rolls $5-18, entrees $10-18 — consistent with 2026 SD pricing, not stale). Extracted with pdftotext -layout; most sections pair name-to-price cleanly on the same line. Deliberately EXCLUDED one table: the a-la-carte Sashimi priced by 3-pieces/5-pieces (Albacore, Sweet Shrimp, Yellowtail, Salmon, Scallop, Surf Clam, Bluefin Tuna, Octopus, Red Shrimp, Kohada, Suzuki, Toro) — that table's two-column layout scrambled under text extraction (numbers land on the wrong rows) and could not be paired to names with confidence, matching the playbook's documented multi-column PDF failure mode. Also excluded the promotional 'Nigiri Sushi Wednesday' discount pricing (not the standing menu price) and Gyu Don extra-topping add-ons (not standalone dishes). Sections covered: Drinks, Sake, Desserts, Fried Foods, Salad/Soup/Steam Rice, Special Appetizer, Nigiri (1pc), Handroll, Sashimi Sampler, Super Handroll, Combos, Hosomaki, Rice Bowls, Sushi Rolls, Specialty Rolls, Set Meals (Teishoku), Ramen & Udon, Fried Rice & Curry, Yakisoba, Donburi, Lunch Special, Happy Hour. Not covered: the excluded 3pc/5pc sashimi table, and two smaller seasonal 'Special-Deal-menu' PDFs (2022/2024) were not opened since the main menu already covers the core categories.

name: District 6 Gastrobar & Kitchen
notes: district6sd.com embeds its own Slice ordering widget (SliceWidgets script, shopUuid ec350a39-...) but the widget itself is client-rendered, so prices were read from the Slice storefront page directly, which carries a priced schema.org Menu in its JSON-LD (78 items across Pizza, Appetizers, Sides, Bread, Salads, Kebob, Burgers, an Indo-Chinese "Inchins" section, Pasta and Regular Drinks). This is the restaurant's own first-party ordering channel, not a marketplace. Branch confirmed via the restaurant's Toast storefront (toasttab.com/local/district6sd), whose embedded state gives the exact batch address, 8242 Mira Mesa Blvd, San Diego 92126 (Toast itself only carried restaurant metadata, not priced items, so it was not used as the source). Markup test: raw prices land on .99/.00 endings 78/78 times with no divisor producing a cleaner pattern (1.04 -> 0/78, 1.1 -> 4/78, 1.25 -> 6/78) — no fee. The Indian/Indo-Chinese-heavy menu (pizza toppings like Paneer Tikka, a full "Inchins" Indo-Chinese section) looks unusual for a place billed as a gastrobar, but the address and name match confirmed via Toast, and this is simply the concept the kitchen runs online-ordering under. Did not find a separate alcohol/bar-drinks menu on Slice — likely a dine-in-only adjunct not carried on the delivery platform.

name: Five Points Bar
notes: This is a corner dive bar (Yelp category: Dive Bars) at 1881 S Escondido Blvd. Own site fivepointssportsbar.com is a Wix site with only four pages (home, events-1, venue, contact) and no menu page, no PDF, and no Wix menu widget anywhere in the HTML. No presence found on any ordering platform (Toast/Square/ChowNow/Slice/DoorDash/UberEats) via search. A WebSearch summary surfaced a review quoting the bartender directly: "this is just a corner bar, we don't have a kitchen." Combined with no menu found anywhere first- or third-party, this reads as a drink-only bar publishing no per-item food prices, which is the textbook not_found case, not a temporary access failure.

name: Little Bird Brewing
notes: A taproom brewery, 3176 Thorn St. Own site (littlebirdbrewing.com, Squarespace) has only /cart /beers /calendar /about /contact — the /beers page lists no prices anywhere in the HTML (no '$' character at all on the page), consistent with a rotating 15+ tap list that does not carry a fixed price board online. WebSearch corroborates: pricing mentioned only informally in reviews ('$2 for the taster', a Sunday $15 beer+food special) with no stable per-beer price list found anywhere (Untappd, BeerAdvocate, Yelp, Facebook checked via search, none surfaced item prices). Food here is served by rotating third-party food trucks, not a kitchen the brewery runs or prices itself, so it is not this restaurant's menu to capture. This is the playbook's documented case of a brewery beer board that genuinely prints no per-item prices, not a temporary access failure.

name: L&L Hawaiian Barbeque
notes: L&L is a chain and locations are individually owned/operated with their own pricing (per the chain site's own disclaimer), so the chain-wide hawaiianbarbecue.com/menu page carries no prices at all (pure Next.js RSC shell, 0 dollar-amount matches) and was not used. The National City location page (hawaiianbarbecue.com/locations/national-city) links to a location-specific first-party LoyaltyPlant ordering storefront, order.loyaltyplant.com/hawaiianbarbecue/8255, which is a client-rendered SPA with no JSON embedded in the raw HTML (0 curl-visible prices) so it was read via the shared browser pane in one batch of page-text reads. Branch confirmed in-page: 'San Diego: National City, 1860-B Sweetwater Rd. National City, CA 91950' — matches the batch address (1860 Sweetwater Road) exactly. The store showed 'not accepting orders yet, come back at 10:00 AM' (closed-store time gate) but the full priced menu still rendered underneath, the same pattern as the Clover/COLO2 closed-gate cases in the playbook, so this is not a partial. 105 items across Island Breakfast, Combination Plates, Beef and Pork Plates, Chicken Plates, Seafood Plates, Healthier Plates, Burgers and Sandwiches, Saimin, Musubi, Side Orders, Keiki Meals, Drinks, Salads and Packs (family/party). Markup test: prices land on .99/.49/.29/.39/.19/.09-style endings raw, and no uniform divisor (1.04-1.25) produces a cleaner pattern than the raw prices, so no fee is present — this is standing first-party pricing.
